Effect: ＜Iceclad＞ (Other than against Security Digimon, compare the number of digivolution cards instead of DP in this Digimon's battles.)
[On Play] [When Digivolving] Trash the bottom 2 digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, if your opponent has no Digimon with digivolution cards, gain 1 memory.
